def identify(path):
    value = run([MAGICK, \"identify\", \"-format\", \"%wx%h\", str(path)], text=True).strip()
    return tuple(int(v) for v in value.split(\"x\"))

        run([MAGICK, str(source_root / mentry[\"path\"]), \"-resize\", f\"x{render_height}\", str(mthumb)])
        assert_equal(identify(dthumb), (desktop_width, render_height), f\"desktop derived dimensions {key}\")

        run([
            MAGICK, \"-size\", f\"{pair_width}x{render_height}\", \"xc:#ffffff\",
            str(dthumb), \"-geometry\", \"+0+0\", \"-composite\",
            str(mthumb), \"-geometry\", f\"+{desktop_width + 16}+0\", \"-composite\",
            str(pair),
        ])
        lines = [
            f\"{ordinal:02d} | {key} | route {surface['path']}\",
            f\"desktop-1440x900 | SHA256 {dentry['png_sha256']}\",
            f\"mobile-390x844 | SHA256 {mentry['png_sha256']}\",

            \"-font\", FONT, \"-pointsize\", \"9\", \"-fill\", \"#1f2933\", \"-gravity\", \"NorthWest\",
        ]
        for y, line in zip((16, 37, 58, 79), lines):
            label_args += [\"-annotate\", f\"+8+{y}\", line]
        label_args += [str(label)]
        run(label_args)
        board_png = root / f\"{key}.board.png\"
        run([MAGICK, str(label), str(pair), \"-append\", str(board_png)])
        board_entries.append({
            \"ordinal\": ordinal,
            \"surface_key\": key,
            \"route\": surface[\"path\"],
            \"desktop\": {
                \"source_path\": dentry[\"path\"], \"source_sha256\": dentry[\"png_sha256\"],
